# Design

Extend Keith's current domains and ordinary turn path. Canonical evidence and operational state remain authoritative; indexes, relations, summaries, and user-pattern models are subordinate projections or explicitly inferential records. A versioned world supplies stable action semantics, while observations update state and test conditional expectations. One admission owner dispatches effects, one lifecycle owner governs convergence, and one finalization owner commits answers. Reusable Python functions and adapted skill content broaden capability without importing another agent runtime.

## Authority, scope, and milestones

This spec.kvx is the implementation contract for this proposed feature. Its design sections and acceptance criteria are normative. Earlier research supplies rationale; where language differs, this consolidated spec controls this feature. Existing security and dependency invariants still apply. Generated requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md are views.

Canonical source is spec/keith-causal-intelligence/spec.kvx, activated by explicit user request on 2026-09-05. Generated views live beside it. Research rationale remains under .research; there is no second editable spec copy. Other feature task statuses remain unchanged.

- M1: real teaching loop plus three to five usable skills, four document writers, and the representative artifact journey; an equivalent existing projection may satisfy the projection requirement
- M2: conditional transfer, evaluated reconstruction, evaluated latent retention, readers, a search adapter, source monitoring, speech, and one inbox/channel integration
- M3: complete corpus, provider, migration, packaged-runtime, cross-client, and handoff qualification; all required tasks have evidence

M1 is a usable milestone, not completion of this whole spec. Experimental layers may remain disabled after a completed and reported inconclusive or negative evaluation; unimplemented layers are not completed experiments. A capability may be satisfied by a proved Keith equivalent. Deferred implementations remain pending and are named in the handoff.

## Existing owners and dependency direction

agent-types owns shared IDs and revisions; protocol, framing, provider-core, tool-core, kernel-protocol, runtime-api, and platform-contracts own values that cross their existing boundaries. A record used only within memory stays in memory. Task 1.3 maps fields before introducing types; names below are logical contracts, not instructions to duplicate existing types.

memory owns source authority, anchor validity, canonical corrections, hypothesis and relationship policy, required-binding resolution, selection, and the semantic-candidate port. Preserve existing authorities by record family: memory-ledger.json owns consolidation MemoryRecords, memory-vault.jsonl owns EvidenceRecord mutations, and relationship-events.jsonl owns explicit onboarding/name state. Atlas, caches, and indexes are rebuildable; the vault is not disposable. retrieval implements the memory candidate port through an allowed dependency. provider-adapters implements provider-core transport and must not acquire a transitive session-store dependency through retrieval.

action-store owns whole SessionAction lifecycle; session-store history owns committed tool call/result records. tool-core owns admission and effect-aware retry; agent-loop owns convergence and finalization; local-runtime composes services and context. daemon-core already has OperationJournal recovery, currently disconnected from ordinary tool dispatch; extend/wire existing ownership through lower contracts rather than adding a competing journal. Its heterogeneous ActiveOperations collection needs record-kind discrimination before general use. Existing scheduler/waiting owns durable jobs. framing is byte transport only; world frames belong at the tool admission contract and activation manifests remain in session-store.

evolution, task-recipe, and skills own experience reuse and reviewed procedure adoption. meta-harness and self-evolution remain the independently governed route for code changes. This feature does not relax any existing protected surface.

kernel-broker/tool-runner execute bounded Python work; artifacts/workspace own artifact and path access; web/provider-adapters own network adapters; credentials/profile/data-control own access; scheduler/initiative own monitors; channel-core/channel-adapters/delivery own inbox and send state; ui-model and existing apps render projections.

Use cargo dependency-policy for new edges. If the existing layer policy prevents a proposed adapter, move the interface to its proper existing contract layer and document the resolution; do not suppress the check or make a domain depend on an application.

## Stable causal semantics and durable transitions

The same action under equivalent relevant preconditions has the same declared semantics. Incidental differences can transfer; relevant conditions, object revisions, grants, external uncertainty, and adapter guarantees may change the outcome. Runtime laws are enforced; adapter promises are versioned; learned regularities are conditional and revisable.

WorldVersion identifies native action schemas, legal transitions, and outcome vocabulary. CapabilityEpoch identifies installed binding versions and available grants. WorldFrame names those versions plus task, object revisions, active commitments, and pending effects. Changing the selected context subset of existing tools does not itself change their semantics.

Native semantic changes require an explicit world transition; binding installation/removal/version or grant changes require an explicit capability transition. An admitted action retains its original contract and operation identity. Dispatch rechecks current grants and revisions; incompatible unexecuted attempts are rejected or re-admitted with recorded lineage. Unknown executed effects remain subject to their original reconciliation rules.

Use the existing ToolEffectState transition vocabulary. Conceptually: proposal -> admitted and durably linked prediction -> dispatch -> observed not-committed, committed, or unknown effect -> reconciliation when supported. Persist a dispatch marker before handing control to the adapter; a crash in the dispatch window is conservatively unknown unless non-execution is established. Neither timeout nor evaluator error supplies proof of non-commitment.

Derive operation equivalence from typed task, canonical target, intended effect, mechanism, and adapter key where available. Route changes and superficial argument changes cannot intentionally bypass known equivalence. Do not claim equivalence detection across arbitrary code; record unsupported reconciliation explicitly and prohibit an automatic repeat of the same unresolved write.

## Minimum record contracts

EvidenceAnchor extends existing evidence ID, source entry/digest, profile, sensitivity, authority, observation and recording times, validity/correction lineage with effective interval and source-root identity where absent. An anchor proves an attributable statement or observation, not every interpretation of it.

TaskObjectBinding = task/scope + canonical entity + property + current evidence ID/revision + freshness requirement + resolved/missing/stale/conflicting status. Resolve corrections by identity and effective time; an ambiguous entity remains ambiguous.

Hypothesis = claim + anchor roots + conditions + alternatives + counterevidence + generator/model/representation version + proposed/supported/disputed/retired state. Supported is inferential status, never a change into observed provenance.

Relationship = typed endpoints + temporal/entity/task/evidential/causal/procedural/analogical type + asserted/observed/inferred origin + scope + independent support roots + counterevidence + validity/revision. Causal and analogical proposals start inferential.

Prediction = immutable ID/revision + task/attempt/operation linkage + WorldVersion/CapabilityEpoch + target and precondition revisions + evidence/hypothesis references + bounded expected predicates + observation deadlines + uncertainty. Freeze before dispatch; superseding an unexecuted prediction creates a new linked record.

Assessment = prediction/predicate ID + supported/contradicted/pending/unresolvable/not_executed + observation IDs/revisions + evaluator/version + time + unresolved reason. Later evidence appends a revision. Effect, process, transport, and goal statuses are separate.

StrategyRecord = task/target/intended effect/mechanism/preconditions + attempts + source roots + failed expectations + remaining existing budgets + revision lineage. Model-generated strategy names cannot reset it.

ProcedureExperience = conditional strategy + expected outcomes + adapter/world compatibility + independent supporting episodes + failures/counterexamples + applicability and adoption history. Executable adoption remains a separate reviewed transition.

RetrievalManifest = profile/task + query representation digest + canonical source revision + encoder/index generation + candidate lanes + selected IDs/revisions + required coverage/gaps + actual included IDs + degraded reasons. Record use from downstream observations separately from selection and inclusion.

UserPatternHypothesis = scoped interpretation + attributable user-signal roots + alternatives/counterexamples + time window + explicit correction/rejection + expiry/review + measured later utility + self-caused interaction markers.

Projection and assessment jobs carry profile, source/revision or prediction ID, deterministic job identity, lease/attempt state, retry/backoff, and watermark. Canonical commit plus job intent is transactional where the existing store allows; otherwise replay by source revision closes the explicitly documented window.

## Embedding, relationships, and context assembly

Configure chat and embeddings independently. Start with one trained encoder selected on development evidence; a permitted trained local encoder is acceptable. Benchmark a hosted and local candidate when available, reporting unavailable candidates. Hash/trigram features remain a lexical baseline. Do not silently export existing local memory to a hosted service.

A vector belongs to encoder identity/revision, dimensions, distance/normalization, input role, representation version, and index generation. Query and document roles must be compatible. A second model uses its own populated generation even when dimensions match. Fuse ranks over canonical IDs, not raw scores from unrelated spaces.

Canonical writes immediately support exact lookup. Durable jobs build optional projections with bounded recent-unindexed lexical retrieval. On outage preserve sources and jobs, back off, and report lag. Build new generations side by side, validate before atomic active-pointer switch, and retain a compatible prior generation within retention policy.

Begin with observation-meaning and action/precondition/outcome representations. Enable further goal, procedure, hypothesis, or modality views only after measured incremental value. Generated representations retain inferred origin. Multiple hits from one source root count as one observation.

- Current task, authority, capability/object revisions, pending effects, and relevant commitments
- Required exact bindings and applicable corrections
- Optional related anchors from exact, lexical, trained semantic, and bounded relation retrieval
- Conditional procedures with counterexamples and scoped optional patterns
- Optional labeled generated reconstruction with unresolved alternatives

Initial experiment defaults: required frame target ceiling 4000 tokens; optional recollection ceiling 8000 tokens, both constrained by remaining model context. Required state cannot be silently dropped: narrow the active subtask or fetch bounded detail before dependent dispatch. Optional graph traversal is at most two hops and 200 visited nodes; required correction closure must still resolve or expose a gap/cycle.

semantic_ready requires current compatible encoder, acceptable coverage, and a successful actual-turn probe. semantic_lagging denotes useful semantic service with backlog/partial coverage. lexical_only denotes no usable permitted semantic path. unavailable denotes required underlying service unavailable. Report encoder, backlog, projection, and actual inclusion independently.

## Prediction, convergence, and conditional learning

- Object exists in a named authoritative scope
- Object revision or digest equals the admitted expected value
- Operation receipt matches the durable operation identity
- Typed property satisfies an explicit bounded predicate
- Process terminated with an observed result
- Answer committed; transport acknowledgement is a separate predicate

Consequential actions carry compact predictions and runtime-defined success requirements. Diagnostic probes name the hypothesis and distinguishing observation. Routine reads use lightweight observation intent without mandatory extra model calls. Subjective goal assessments cite existing review or explicit user feedback; the model cannot redefine success after seeing results.

Immediately reconcile an unknown consequential effect; reject known invalid preconditions before dispatch. For otherwise admissible same-mechanism failures without useful information, initially require revision after three unsuccessful attempts, with at most two revision rounds and five additional diagnostic probes total, all within existing task/turn budgets. These are experiment parameters, never permission to repeat an unsafe action three times.

A revision names the failed expectation, relevant evidence, alternative explanation, and authorized discriminating next step. Relevant disconfirmation counts as information. Different error strings, rephrasing, or repeated observations alone do not. Stop or durable wait when no informative authorized step remains.

An episode is experience immediately. One attributable episode permits tentative conditional advice. Broader reuse initially requires at least three independent relevant episodes, a changed-condition test, and considered counterexamples; this is an experimental minimum rather than statistical certainty. Contradiction narrows/suspends immediately. Recipe adoption and source evolution use their existing stronger gates.

Optional reflection, indexing, reconstruction, and personalization failures cannot suppress an already valid answer. Predictions/assessments return typed findings to the existing lifecycle owner. Preserve candidate, committed final, and delivery acknowledgement states through restart and all clients.

## Generated connective memory without evidence laundering

Generate possible connections among selected anchors on demand, with anchor IDs, alternatives, missing evidence, and generator/version. Keep reconstruction ephemeral by default; retained text is a hypothesis. Exact dates, quotes, identifiers, events, and action states require source support.

Deterministic checks establish valid references, exact quotation, allowed classes, and compatible revisions. They cannot establish arbitrary prose entailment. Bounded claim checking and held-out unsupported-claim evaluation supplement structural checks. On failure discard the optional reconstruction and retain the anchor answer.

Summaries, compaction, replay, embedding views, and consolidation preserve inferential origin and original source roots. Re-ingesting a quote from an assistant transcript does not create independent external evidence. Corrections/deletions invalidate dependent narrative and indexes.

## Latent relatedness and optional retention

Operational obligations are retained by their owning lifecycle. Explicit remember requests, corrections, decisive exceptions, and active-lesson sources receive protected priority within user retention rules. Optional experience is selected under a budget. Protection never means undeletable; a forget request removes memory content while minimal unresolved operation state remains with its lifecycle owner.

Initial recent-signal buffer limit is seven days or 50 MiB of sanitized text, whichever is reached first, with stricter profile policy taking precedence. Do not duplicate secrets, screenshots, or full transcripts by default. Expired sources remain gaps.

Generate at most three competing scoped patterns per consolidation group initially, using distinct user-signal roots, alternatives, and counterexamples. A work topic does not imply a personal preference. Current requests and explicit corrections outrank inferred preferences. Record feedback caused by Keith itself.

For optional candidates only, normalize features to [0,1] and start S = 4*goal + 3*explicit_importance + 2*measured_usefulness + 2*novelty + 3*exception_value - storage_cost. Unknown measured usefulness is zero. Freeze coefficients before the experiment; no self-modifying scorer in the first version.

Initially reserve 20 percent of optional retention for rare events, counterexamples, and unexplained novel signals. Redistribution and ties must be deterministic and logged when eligible candidates are insufficient. Neither exposure nor silence establishes usefulness.

A rejected preference stops influencing behavior immediately. Retain only the correction permitted by policy to prevent re-inference from remaining signals; stronger deletion requests prevail. Deleting a signal invalidates dependent patterns and resets unsupported utility/support counts.

## Gideon breadth through bounded reuse

Inspect /root/Gideon/Gideon-ai and /root/Gideon/Gideon-ai-apps at recorded revisions. Record exact donor files, license/dependency provenance, Keith equivalent, missing user behavior, changed imports/boundaries, platforms, artifact size, and real proof. Package counts describe inventory only.

Classify candidates as content/pure function, IO adapter, or stateful controller. Reuse Python models/codecs/writers and pure projectors where practical. Replace IO through Keith-owned boundaries. Do not import Gideon stores, gateway, approvals, updater, installer, shared virtual environment, or another agent loop.

Use existing tool admission -> bounded Python capability function -> structured result/output artifact -> Keith persistence and normal UI. The host owns credentials, path resolution, side effects, cancellation, and finalization. A worker cannot access session/memory stores or declare task completion. Use MCP only when it reduces this slice's work; its general configuration product is not a prerequisite.

Adapt three to five skills for document authoring, grounded research, work checking, and browser verification where tools exist. Extract one writer first, then DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and PDF. Include a projection only when it adds missing behavior. Demonstrate a real downloadable document reopened after restart.

Gideon YAML-frontmatter skills are not Keith TOML +++ SkillManifest files. Map required_tools and references, fix the Keith scaffold/runtime mismatch and profile selection gap, then prove real turn selection. Writers return bytes from structured models; reading requires separate path/format/source-coordinate treatment. Spreadsheet formula preservation is not formula evaluation; conversion is not universally lossless.

After the shared slice, provide representative document readers, one additional search/extraction adapter, source-monitoring recipes, transcription/speech, and one inbox/channel path. Each family has explicit readiness, dependency, authority, cancellation, malformed-input, and restart behavior. Existing equivalents may satisfy the family with real-path evidence.

Inventory full Minutes/Growth apps, workflow editor, synchronization, device companions, remaining native/external apps, and specialized providers. Give each a destination, gap, dependency, and follow-on scope. These higher-effort products are not silently called implemented and do not become prerequisites for a writer.

## Verification contract and evidence levels

Task 1.1 introduces scripts/qualification/causal_intelligence.py with baseline execution; task 1.2 extends its versioned case manifests under tests/causal-intelligence. Every task verify_cmd refers to that PLANNED runner, not an existing or already passing command. The runner must reject missing cases, zero tests, stale artifacts, skipped required journeys, failed subprocesses, and source/version mismatches. It must not accept a hand-written pass file as proof.

The runner maps --task to explicit unit/transport/process/browser cases, executes them, asserts nonzero expected case counts, and writes bounded evidence keyed by current source/binary/config versions. Rust tasks run focused cargo test --locked and strict clippy --all-targets --no-deps --locked with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and a disposable external CARGO_TARGET_DIR cleaned on exit. New dependency edges run cargo dependency-policy. UI changes run package checks plus real interactions.

Use genuine Keith orchestration and owning stores. Fault injection is allowed at an unavoidable external boundary, including a separate durable test service that commits then drops an acknowledgement. Internal canned success collaborators do not qualify wiring. Unit tests, deterministic process evidence, live provider evidence, packaged runtime, and release qualification are distinct.

Use isolated profiles, sanitized data, disposable resources, and existing approval boundaries. If provider credentials or an external target are unavailable, report blocked and return non-success for the corresponding qualification; never replace it with a fake success. This spec does not authorize external deployment or production mutation.

C01-C20 below are required regressions. B01-B10 cover capability acquisition. Every case records initial state, canonical/source/contract versions, stimulus or injected fault, expected observations, actual evidence, result, and remaining ambiguity.

Compare A current Keith, B stable truth plus exact/lexical anchors, C B plus trained semantic activation and predictions, D C plus conditional lessons, E D plus reconstruction, and F chosen accepted configuration plus pattern retention. Add semantic-only versus prediction-only arms when attributing C improvements. Evaluate latent selectors separately with retrieval/reasoning fixed.

Hold chat model, task families, context ceiling, and total work budgets fixed; split chronologically and by task/entity family. Keep held-out data out of lesson generation, prompt tuning, self-evolution, and gate tuning. Initially run at least three replicates per stochastic case and report every run. Full-context diagnostics are labeled as unequal-budget references.

Report required-binding resolution and actual inclusion, recall@K, counterexample coverage, freshness, verified task success, duplicate effects, false completion, unsupported factual claims, stale/cross-profile use, invalid proposals, repeated actions, useful probes, revisions, interruptions, conditional transfer/negative transfer, later usefulness, repeated questions, p50/p95 latency, tokens, embedding spend, storage, and recovery time. Calibration is measured only on resolved predictions; unresolved and delayed rates are separate.

Initial gates: zero protected-invariant violations in tested cases; 100 percent actual inclusion for resolved required test bindings; semantic recall@10 at least 95 percent on a frozen 200-query low-overlap paraphrase set; ordinary-task success loss no greater than two percentage points against baseline. Record counts and uncertainty, and withhold a positive conclusion when uncertainty prevents it. Freeze development-selected thresholds before held-out evaluation; no relaxation to pass a failed candidate.

Reconstruction and latent retention each need improvement on a predeclared target at matched budget without material unsupported-claim, success, or intervention regression. An inconclusive result retains the simpler accepted configuration. Optional disabling cannot remove provenance, exact truth, authority, or pending-effect protections.

## Required causal and memory cases

Missing encoder: canonical writes survive, exact recall works, health degrades honestly, and no hashed fallback reports semantic readiness.

Chat-provider switch: independent embedding identity, credentials references, index, and actual automatic recall survive.

Space mismatch: wrong encoder/revision/dimensions/input role/representation is rejected without contaminated writes or search.

Unindexed fresh memory: required fact resolves immediately, optional recent lane is bounded, and lag is reported.

Crowded recall: corrected required binding survives 10000 distractors and reaches the actual proposed action.

Plausible wrong identifier: known binding is checked; a guessed domain and plausible page cannot establish that the real service is defunct.

Corrected endpoint and removed capability: new binding wins; old procedure and tool assumptions trigger refresh and cannot recreate a removed tool.

Rejected final: uncommitted candidate is never delivered history or evidence that the user was answered.

Lost acknowledgement and restart: scoped idempotent/readback adapter produces one actual effect; unknown persists until authoritative reconciliation.

Shell exit zero plus application error: process success, effect, and goal outcomes remain distinct.

Assessor timeout/malformed output: unresolved assessment, no automatic confirmation or discharged obligation.

Alternating argument/route variants and compaction: same failed mechanism consumes durable strategy allowance and causes useful revision.

Useful disconfirmation: relevant contrary evidence counts as information while repeated observations do not.

Repeated reconstruction/quotation/consolidation: inferred origin and source-root count remain unchanged.

Correction and forgetting: dependent patterns, summaries, caches, vectors, restart, rebuild, and supported backup restore cannot revive stale/deleted content.

Preference reversal: explicit correction overrides earlier repeated signals; counterexamples survive optional selection.

Conditional transfer: incidental changes permit reuse; changed causal preconditions require narrowing or abstention.

Ordinary successful turn: no needless reflection, permission ceremony, global tool stripping, or suppressed valid final.

Isolation and hostile content: no other-profile result, cache hit, batch leakage, credential exposure, or authority from retrieved instructions.

Stop/disconnect/reopen/resume: stop halts new dispatch; in-flight effects, commitments, and committed answers remain truthful and consistent.

## Required capability cases

Curated skill selects in a real turn only when profile-enabled and its required tools are actually ready; incompatible manifest fails visibly.

Generate DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF from structured input, inspect actual content/rendering, download through normal UI, and reopen after daemon restart.

Missing Python dependency/model or unsupported platform reports unavailable; timeout/cancel kills bounded work and leaves no falsely committed artifact.

Malformed/traversal/symlink/oversized/compressed document input is rejected within limits; readers preserve source coordinates and mark extraction gaps.

Projection is smaller and useful while full permitted output and decisive error/correction evidence remain retrievable under Keith access rules.

Search adapter uses opaque credentials, bounded network access, attributed URLs/times and errors; hostile snippets do not become instructions.

Source monitor detects meaningful new items, resumes from durable cursor, avoids duplicate delivery after restart, and honors pause/removal.

Transcription and speech work with real audio, report model/version and platform readiness, cancel correctly, and preserve profile-scoped artifacts.

Inbox/channel account and thread ownership hold; duplicate ingress and lost send acknowledgement recover through existing delivery contracts without unsupported exactly-once claims.

Donor package works in packaged Keith without a Gideon daemon, memory database, approval service, updater, or shared-venv installer.

## Migration, controls, and evidence handoff

Start with additive versioned records and explicit reader compatibility. Backfill only attributable sources. Use resumable checkpoints including canonical revisions and deletion state. Never upgrade historical assistant statements into observations. Do not enable new durable writes until downgrade behavior is known.

Retain prior compatible index generation and config. Rollback can disable optional retrieval/assessment generation/reconstruction/pattern scoring, but preserves immutable predictions already dispatched, pending effects, assessments, provenance, corrections, grants, and delivery state. If an old binary cannot read new records, block unsafe downgrade and use the documented compatible restoration path.

Use independent scoped configuration for semantic retrieval, prediction assessment, reconstruction, and optional pattern retention. Prediction recording and core truth protections remain enforced for admitted effects once migrated; disabling optional assessment work leaves those outcomes explicitly pending/unresolved. Capability packages have their own readiness/enablement.

Local baseline -> isolated daemon proof -> full first teaching and artifact slices -> shadow optional inference -> bounded adoption using existing controls -> packaged qualification. No production deployment is implied. Export only bounded redacted metadata for diagnostics.

For every task, record owning call path, source/binary/schema versions, exact commands and case counts/results, failed/skipped/blocked cases, migration/rollback state, and next dependencies. Code implemented, focused tests passed, real runtime exercised, packaged runtime qualified, and production released are separate claims.
